summary: VALIDATION of v179 duplicate-startup-icon fix. Reproduced the exact iteration_107 recipe (fresh Playwright context + /api/notes** stubbed to []) on both desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) viewports and polled the DOM every 100ms for ~6s. In v178 baseline the DOM contained TWO nodes for ~1300ms (splash rabbit + empty-state-rabbit). In v179 the max concurrent count of img[src*='icon-192'] is 1 across the ENTIRE startup window on both viewports — the only rabbit ever present is the boot splash. The empty-state fallback now renders a NotebookPen lucide-react SVG with data-testid='empty-state-glyph' (verified visible in screenshots, notebook icon with pen). data-testid='empty-state-rabbit' is completely absent from the DOM at all timestamps.
verdict: PASS — duplicate startup icon repair is confirmed on both viewports.

timeline_key_frames.t=500ms: 1 icon-192 img (splash), splashOpacity=1, glyph=true (React mounted, empty state rendered as SVG — no duplicate)

notes_and_caveats: The uncategorized empty state (NotesApp.jsx:2647-2660, data-testid='uncategorized-empty-state') STILL uses . Per iteration_107 diagnosis this branch is NOT the source of the reported duplicate (it only fires when filterBy==='uncategorized', not on default startup with filterBy='all'). However, if a user first-loads the app in Chrome Incognito AND their last filterBy was persisted as 'uncategorized' AND they had no uncategorized notes, the duplicate could theoretically re-appear via that branch. Not reproducible under default startup conditions — filed as a minor consistency note, not a regression.

The boot splash still uses the fixed-timer approach (~1400ms hide + 380ms fade + 500ms unmount). Not addressed by v179 and not required for this fix since the collision partner (the React empty-state rabbit) has been eliminated. iteration_107's 'ir-app-ready handshake' recommendation remains open as a potential future robustness improvement but is NOT required to close this bug.

critical_code_review_comments: The v179 change is minimal, targeted, and correct. It removes the exact DOM node identified as the duplication partner in iteration_107 (data-testid='empty-state-rabbit') and replaces it with a semantically appropriate NotebookPen SVG glyph via lucide-react — no bundle-size or dependency additions since lucide-react is already imported.

Good practice: kept data-testid='empty-state-glyph' (renamed from 'empty-state-rabbit') so any test still targeting the old id will fail loudly rather than silently pass. Consider grepping other tests/playbooks for 'empty-state-rabbit' to update references if any.
The isDark-aware text-slate-500 / text-gray-400 conditional class preserves theme contrast for the new glyph. Verified visually in both dark screenshots.
Comment in the diff explains the rationale for the swap in-line — good documentation hygiene.
